  .container{width:90%;max-width:1200px;margin:auto;}

  input[type="submit"],input[type="button"]{background:#0b4f6c;color:wheat;border:none;padding:10px 20px;font-size:16px;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;width:auto;}

  nav{background:#0b4f6c;padding:15px;text-align:center;}
  nav a{color:white;text-decoration:none;margin:0 15px;font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;display:inline-block;padding:8px 15px;transition:0.3s;}
  nav a:hover{background:white;color:#0b4f6c;border-radius:5px;}
  .hero{background:#0b4f6c;color:white;text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;}
  .hero h1{font-size:40px;margin-bottom:15px;color:white;background:none;}
  .hero p{font-size:20px;margin-bottom:20px;}
  .hero button{background:orange;color:white;padding:12px 25px;border:none;border-radius:5px;cursor:pointer;margin:10px;font-size:16px;}
  .hero button:hover{background:darkorange;}
  .logo{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid white;display:block;margin:20px auto;background:#000;}
  .worker-card{border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:8px;padding:15px;margin:10px;display:inline-block;width:260px;vertical-align:top;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);}
  #workerList{text-align:center;}
  .security-note{font-size:13px;color:#555;background:#fff8e1;border-left:4px solid orange;padding:8px 12px;margin-top:-10px;margin-bottom:15px;border-radius:4px;}
</style>

<p>A platform that connects skilled workers and labourers with local customers in Ambedkar Nagar without middlemen.</p>

<h2>Project Objective</h2>
<p>Our goal is to help customers easily find trusted workers such as plumbers, electricians, carpenters, painters, and other skilled professionals.</p>

<h2>Our Services</h2>
<ul>
  <li>Plumber</li><li>Electrician</li><li>Carpenter</li><li>Painter</li>
  <li>Mason</li><li>Welder</li><li>Driver</li><li>Cleaner</li><li>Data Entry Operator</li>
</ul>
<p>We connect customers with trusted workers quickly and safely. Our platform is easy to use, secure, and reliable.</p>

    <option>Electrician</option>
    <option>Carpenter</option>
    <option>Painter</option>

    <option>Welder</option>
    <option>Driver</option>
    <option>Cleaner</option>
    <option>Data Entry Operator</option>

<!--
  =====================================================================
  IMPORTANT: Do NOT mix Firebase (type="module") logic with the core
  button functions in one block. If the Firebase module fails to load
  (slow network, blocked CDN, ad-blocker, offline testing, CSP, etc.)
  the ENTIRE module script stops executing -- and because ALL window.x
  assignments were inside that one module, EVERY button on the page
  breaks at once. That was the actual bug: not each function individually,
  but the whole module silently failing and taking every handler with it.

  FIX: core UI functions (login, search, booking, OTP, payment, admin,
  location, call) are now in a normal <script> tag that always runs,
  independent of Firebase. Only worker registration (saveWorker) talks
  to Firestore, and it is wrapped in try/catch so a Firebase failure
  only affects that one button, not the whole site.
  =====================================================================
-->

<script>
// ---------- LOGIN ----------
function loginUser() {
  const mobile = document.getElementById("loginMobile").value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById("loginPassword").value.trim();

  if (mobile === "" || password === "") {
    alert("⚠ Please enter Mobile Number and Password");
    return;
  }

  alert("✅ Login Successful");
  document.getElementById("customerName").innerText = mobile;
}
window.loginUser = loginUser;

// ---------- SEARCH ----------
function searchWorker() {
  const input = document.getElementById("searchBox").value.toLowerCase().trim();
  const workers = document.getElementById("workerList").innerText.toLowerCase();

  if (input === "") {
    alert("⚠ Please type something to search.");
    return;
  }

  if (workers.includes(input)) {
    alert("✅ Worker Found");
  } else {
    alert("❌ No Worker Found");
  }
}
window.searchWorker = searchWorker;

// ---------- LOCATION ----------
function openLocation(url) {
  window.open(url, "_blank");
}
window.openLocation = openLocation;

// ---------- BOOK WORKER (quick book from card) ----------
function bookWorker(name) {
  document.getElementById("assignedWorker").innerText = name;
  document.getElementById("bookingForm").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
  alert("You're booking " + name + ". Please fill the booking form below to confirm.");
}
window.bookWorker = bookWorker;

// ---------- BOOKING FORM ----------
let currentBookingId = null;
let generatedOTP = null;

function confirmBooking() {
  const name = document.getElementById("bookingName").value.trim();
  const mobile = document.getElementById("bookingMobile").value.trim();
  const address = document.getElementById("bookingAddress").value.trim();
  const date = document.getElementById("bookingDate").value;
  const time = document.getElementById("bookingTime").value;

  if (name === "" || mobile === "" || address === "" || date === "" || time === "") {
    alert("⚠ Please fill all booking details.");
    return;
  }

  currentBookingId = "BK" + Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000);
  generatedOTP = String(Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000));

  document.getElementById("bookingStatus").innerText = "Booking Confirmed - Awaiting OTP Verification";
  document.getElementById("bookingId").innerText = currentBookingId;
  document.getElementById("dashboardBookingId").innerText = currentBookingId;
  document.getElementById("customerName").innerText = name;
  document.getElementById("dashboardStatus").innerText = "Pending Verification";

  document.getElementById("totalBookings").innerText =
    Number(document.getElementById("totalBookings").innerText) + 1;
  document.getElementById("totalCustomers").innerText =
    Number(document.getElementById("totalCustomers").innerText) + 1;

  document.getElementById("workerNotification").innerText =
    "New Booking Request from " + name + " (" + date + " " + time + ")";

  const historyDiv = document.getElementById("bookingHistory");
  if (historyDiv.innerText.trim() === "No Booking Yet") historyDiv.innerText = "";
  historyDiv.innerHTML += "<p>" + currentBookingId + " - " + name + " - " + date + " " + time + "</p>";

  alert("✅ Booking Confirmed! Your Booking ID: " + currentBookingId +
        "\n(Demo OTP: " + generatedOTP + ")");
}
window.confirmBooking = confirmBooking;

// ---------- OTP ----------
function verifyOTP() {
  const entered = document.getElementById("otpInput").value.trim();

  if (!generatedOTP) {
    document.getElementById("otpStatus").innerText = "⚠ Please confirm a booking first.";
    return;
  }

  if (entered === generatedOTP) {
    document.getElementById("otpStatus").innerText = "✅ OTP Verified Successfully";
    document.getElementById("bookingStatus").innerText = "Booking Verified - Worker Assigned";
    document.getElementById("dashboardStatus").innerText = "Verified";
  } else {
    document.getElementById("otpStatus").innerText = "❌ Invalid OTP. Try again.";
  }
}
window.verifyOTP = verifyOTP;

// ---------- PAYMENT ----------
function payNow() {
  if (!currentBookingId) {
    alert("⚠ Please confirm a booking first.");
    return;
  }
  document.getElementById("paymentStatus").innerText = "Payment Completed ✅";
  document.getElementById("dashboardPayment").innerText = "Completed";
  document.getElementById("totalPayments").innerText =
    "₹" + (Number(document.getElementById("totalPayments").innerText.replace("₹","")) + 500);
  alert("✅ Payment Successful!");
}
window.payNow = payNow;

// ---------- ADMIN ACTIONS ----------
function acceptBooking() {
  document.getElementById("workerNotification").innerText = "Booking Accepted ✅";
  document.getElementById("dashboardStatus").innerText = "Accepted";
}
window.acceptBooking = acceptBooking;

function rejectBooking() {
  document.getElementById("workerNotification").innerText = "Booking Rejected ❌";
  document.getElementById("dashboardStatus").innerText = "Rejected";
}
window.rejectBooking = rejectBooking;

// ---------- AADHAAR MASKING HELPER ----------
// Never store or transmit the full Aadhaar number in plain text from the
// browser. This keeps only the last 4 digits, which is the common,
// UIDAI-recommended way to reference an Aadhaar number in a UI/DB.
function maskAadhaar(number) {
  const digits = number.replace(/\D/g, "");
  if (digits.length < 4) return "Invalid";
  return "XXXXXXXX" + digits.slice(-4);
}
window.maskAadhaar = maskAadhaar;
</script>

<!-- Firebase (worker registration only) - isolated so a load failure here
     cannot break any other button on the page -->
<script type="module">
try {
  const { initializeApp } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.16.0/firebase-app.js");
  const { getAnalytics } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.16.0/firebase-analytics.js");
  const { getFirestore, collection, addDoc } = await import("https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/12.16.0/firebase-firestore.js");

  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyD9FESo78bql5arB4TPvO7jM_Ecr4L_kbo",
    authDomain: "ambedkar-nagar-labour-connet.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "ambedkar-nagar-labour-connet",
    storageBucket: "ambedkar-nagar-labour-connet.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "413646541836",
    appId: "1:413646541836:web:e799bf01f5976d7cab0a29",
    measurementId: "G-86DXZYKPXZ"
  };

  const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const analytics = getAnalytics(app);
  const db = getFirestore(app);

  async function saveWorker() {
    const name = document.getElementById("workerName").value.trim();
    const mobile = document.getElementById("workerMobile").value.trim();
    const address = document.getElementById("workerAddress").value.trim();
    const profession = document.getElementById("workerProfession").value;
    const aadhaarRaw = document.getElementById("workerAadhaar").value.trim();

    if (name === "" || mobile === "" || address === "") {
      alert("⚠ Please fill all details.");
      return;
    }

    if (aadhaarRaw !== "" && !/^\d{12}$/.test(aadhaarRaw)) {
      alert("⚠ Aadhaar Number must be exactly 12 digits.");
      return;
    }

    try {
      await addDoc(collection(db, "workers"), {
        name,
        mobile,
        address,
        profession,
        // Only a masked version is stored client-side. Full Aadhaar
        // verification, if you need it, should happen through a
        // secure backend / Cloud Function, never directly from the browser.
        aadhaarMasked: aadhaarRaw ? window.maskAadhaar(aadhaarRaw) : "",
        status: "Available",
        createdAt: new Date()
      });

      alert("✅ Worker Registered Successfully!");

      document.getElementById("workerName").value = "";
      document.getElementById("workerMobile").value = "";
      document.getElementById("workerAddress").value = "";
      document.getElementById("workerAadhaar").value = "";
      document.getElementById("workerProfession").selectedIndex = 0;

    } catch (error) {
      alert("❌ Error: " + error.message);
      console.error(error);
    }
  }

  window.saveWorker = saveWorker;

} catch (err) {
  // If Firebase itself fails to load (network/CDN blocked), only worker
  // registration is affected -- every other button keeps working.
  console.error("Firebase failed to load:", err);
  window.saveWorker = function () {
    alert("⚠ Registration service is temporarily unavailable. Please check your internet connection and try again.");
  };
}
</script>

</body>
</html>
